title: Credential
description: A credential stored in the Credential Vault with named attributes

description.description: Optional description of the credential's purpose

ownerId.description: User ID of the credential owner

attributes.description: List of attribute definitions associated with this credential

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created this credential

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the credential was created

updatedBy.description: ID of the user who last modified this credential

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification
